name: aporic-codex
description: Connects Codex lifecycle hooks to the clean-room Aporic runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Bind Codex sessions and tool effects to Aporic.
interface.longDescription: Loads a bounded role and handoff at session start, applies secure and operable defaults to rough requests, gathers evidence autonomously, gates local tools against exact grants, and seals continuity state.
capabilities: Role operating defaults for rough requests
interface.defaultPrompt: Handle this project using its active Aporic role and decision boundary.
